fields.summary_ko.0: In a JPMorganChase survey of Birmingham area residents, 42% expressed anxiety about personal finances and plan to reduce consumption.
fields.summary_ko.1: 39% of holiday season budgets plan to cut by 25% or more, with dining expected to decline 63%, gifts 50%, and travel 53%.
fields.summary_ko.2: 27% of residents view the local economy positively (6% booming, 18% recovering), with over 50% perceiving home ownership as financial stability.
